project.title: c++ompact
project.summary: C++17 Huffman compression CLI that encodes and decodes files via CMake and Google Test.

items.title: Stop left-shifting the final packed byte before writing padding
items.notes: Code review Critical: Encode places bits in the high end of the byte; an extra <<= padding corrupts non-byte-aligned payloads and breaks round-trips.

items.title: Assign a non-empty code when the tree is a single leaf
items.notes: Code review Critical: One distinct byte currently gets code "", so encode writes no payload and decode yields an empty file.

items.title: Make isFileWritable non-destructive
items.notes: Code review Critical: Opening the output with ofstream as a writability check truncates existing files and can destroy input when paths coincide.

items.title: Reject empty frequency maps and unsafe padding erase
items.notes: Code review Critical: HuffmanTree::build on an empty map is UB; decode padding erase can underflow size_t on short payloads.

items.title: Fail cleanly on truncated trees and null child walks
items.notes: Code review High: Deserialize of truncated '0' nodes and decode left/right walks can null-deref instead of returning a clear error.

items.title: Make Google Test checkout reliable for cmake configure
items.notes: Code review High: README tells users to run git submodule update --init --recursive; ensure googletest is actually pinned and present so add_subdirectory succeeds.

items.title: Link tests against a single Google Test main
items.notes: Code review High: tests/test_huffman.cpp defines main while CMake also links gtest_main.

items.title: Cover single-byte, binary, and non-aligned bit-length round-trips
items.notes: Code review High/Medium: Current suite is thin and CWD-sensitive; strengthen behaviour checks after packing fixes.

items.title: Return non-zero from main when encode or decode fails
items.notes: Code review High: Handlers print errors but main still exits 0; --help currently shares the failure return path.

items.title: Use one error strategy across encode, decode, and frequency utils
items.notes: Code review Medium: Encode throws; decode and calculateFrequencies often cerr+return, so failures are easy to miss.

items.title: Add magic, version, and length or checksum to the compressed format
items.notes: Code review High: Any byte stream is accepted as a tree today; framing rejects non-cppompact files and detects truncation.

items.title: Decode payload bits without building an 8x character string
items.notes: Code review High: Large files expand to roughly eight times payload size in memory during decode.

items.title: Remove or finish unused HuffmanTree serialize/codes paths
items.notes: Code review Medium: serializeTree is declared but undefined; setCodes/getCodes and decodeFile's HuffmanTree& are unused by the real I/O path.

items.title: Stop always creating a hardcoded output directory from main
items.notes: Code review Medium: main always createDirectoryIfNotExists("output") even when the user passes unrelated paths.

items.title: Use 64-bit counters for byte frequencies
items.notes: Code review Medium: int frequencies overflow above ~2^31 occurrences of one byte.

items.title: Provide or generate the sample input the README encodes
items.notes: Code review Medium: README examples use ../input/input.txt, which is not in the repo today.

items.title: Document cmake --build and non-Make Windows generators in the README
items.notes: Code review Medium: Windows section still assumes make; multi-config output dirs are undocumented.

items.title: Turn on -Wall/-Wextra or MSVC /W4 for cppompact_lib
items.notes: Code review Low: Warning flags in CMakeLists.txt are commented out.
